document.title: Notice Establishing Answer Period on PJM's motion for abeyance (answers due 5:00 pm Eastern Time, October 21, 2026)

pages.text:
UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION

PJM Interconnection, L.L.C.
Docket Nos.
ER26-3380-000
EL26-108-000


NOTICE ESTABLISHING ANSWER PERIOD

(October 16, 2026)

On October 13, 2026, pursuant to Rule 212 of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure,[fn:2] PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. (PJM) filed a motion to hold the paper hearing proceedings and the submission of briefs in the above-captioned proceeding in abeyance pending resolution of PJM’s anticipated forthcoming filing that will be submitted under section 205 of the Federal Power Act addressing the issues raised in a September 29, 2026, Commission order.[fn:3]

Upon consideration, notice is hereby given that answers to PJM’s motion are due by 5:00 pm Eastern Time on October 21, 2026. 

							



Carlos D. Clay,
Deputy Secretary.


Footnotes
[fn:2] 18 C.F.R. § 385.212 (2025).
[fn:3] PJM Motion at 1 (citing PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., 196 FERC ¶ 61,245 (2026)).
